config.label: Scoped Shardflux project API key (sfk_<key id>_<secret>)
config.description: Scoped Shardflux project API key (sfk_<key id>_<secret>). Its tool permissions decide which workspace tools are listed.

config.label: API base URL
config.description: API base URL. Plain http:// is allowed only for loopback hosts.

config.label: Pin one workspace: workspace_key becomes optional on every tool and any other key is refused (workspace_pinned)
config.description: Pin one workspace: workspace_key becomes optional on every tool and any other key is refused (workspace_pinned).

config.label: Default and maximum deadline per tool call in milliseconds (1000-3600000)
config.description: Default and maximum deadline per tool call in milliseconds (1000-3600000). A call's timeout_ms can only shorten it.

config.label: on: workspace tools resume a suspended workspace and then run
config.description: on: workspace tools resume a suspended workspace and then run. off: they return the workspace_not_running refusal.

config.label: Longest wait per tool call for a workspace to wake or finish a transition, in milliseconds (1000-3600000; clamped to SHARDFLUX_MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS)
config.description: Longest wait per tool call for a workspace to wake or finish a transition, in milliseconds (1000-3600000; clamped to SHARDFLUX_MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS).

config.label: Attribution label of every tool token this server obtains (shown as an agent session)
config.description: Attribution label of every tool token this server obtains (shown as an agent session).

config.label: Log level of the JSON log lines on stderr (stdout carries the protocol)
config.description: Log level of the JSON log lines on stderr (stdout carries the protocol).

config.label: Unset: private HTTP/1
config.description: Unset: private HTTP/1.1 pooling on Node 26, native fetch elsewhere. 0: force connection closure for diagnosis. 1: select native pooling.

config.label: Offer explicit workspace_hint for tool input streaming (on or off)
config.description: Offer explicit workspace_hint for tool input streaming (on or off).
